title: MAT Agent Configuration — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-16. Defines CLI-based agent bindings for multi-agent orchestration.
notes: CLI delegation model: agents are invoked via CLI tools (claude, codex, gemini), not direct API calls.
No API keys required — each CLI tool manages its own authentication via license/subscription.
Wire formats (MAT-1, MAT-2) define the JSON contracts between agents; this schema defines which CLI handles which role.
